mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_BDPS_ISSU_INFO A WHERE A.PSG_TRNSP_YMD = #{ymd} AND A.CHKN_SE_CD = 'SCI' AND A.TMNL_SE_CD IN ('P01', 'P03') AND A.CHKN_ISTR_NO IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(A.CHKN_ISTR_NO)) > 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY ( TMNL_ID, SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, ALN_CD, PLCY_BGNG_YMD, PLCY_END_YMD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT DISTINCT B.TMNL_SE_CD, TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO), B.ALN_CD, #{ymd}, '99991231', 'SYSTEM', '1.1.1.1', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_BDPS_ISSU_INFO B WHERE B.PSG_TRNSP_YMD = #{ymd} AND B.CHKN_SE_CD = 'SCI' AND B.TMNL_SE_CD IN ('P01', 'P03') AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY A WHERE A.TMNL_ID = B.TMNL_SE_CD AND A.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID = TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) AND A.ALN_CD = B.ALN_CD AND #{ymd} BETWEEN A.PLCY_BGNG_YMD AND A.PLCY_END_YMD )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY A WHERE A.PLCY_BGNG_YMD = #{ymd} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_BDPS_ISSU_INFO B WHERE B.PSG_TRNSP_YMD = #{ymd} AND B.CHKN_SE_CD = 'SCI' AND B.TMNL_SE_CD IN ('P01', 'P03') AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) IS NOT NULL AND B.TMNL_SE_CD = A.TMNL_ID AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) = A.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID AND B.ALN_CD = A.ALN_CD )
mapper.update: UPDATE PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY A SET A.PLCY_END_YMD = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD'), A.LAST_MDFR_ID = 'SYSTEM', A.LAST_MDFR_IP_ADDR = '1.1.1.1', A.LAST_MDFCN_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE A.PLCY_BGNG_YMD < #{ymd} AND #{ymd} BETWEEN A.PLCY_BGNG_YMD AND A.PLCY_END_YMD AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_BDPS_ISSU_INFO B WHERE B.PSG_TRNSP_YMD = #{ymd} AND B.CHKN_SE_CD = 'SCI' AND B.TMNL_SE_CD IN ('P01', 'P03') AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) IS NOT NULL AND B.TMNL_SE_CD = A.TMNL_ID AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) = A.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID AND B.ALN_CD = A.ALN_CD )

UPDATE PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY A SET A.PLCY_END_YMD = '99991231', A.LAST_MDFR_ID = 'SYSTEM', A.LAST_MDFR_IP_ADDR = '1.1.1.1', A.LAST_MDFCN_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE A.PLCY_END_YMD = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_BDPS_ISSU_INFO B WHERE B.PSG_TRNSP_YMD = #{ymd} AND B.CHKN_SE_CD = 'SCI' AND B.TMNL_SE_CD IN ('P01', 'P03') AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) IS NOT NULL AND B.TMNL_SE_CD = A.TMNL_ID AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) = A.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID AND B.ALN_CD = A.ALN_CD ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY X WHERE X.TMNL_ID = A.TMNL_ID AND X.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID = A.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID AND X.ALN_CD = A.ALN_CD AND #{ymd} BETWEEN X.PLCY_BGNG_YMD AND X.PLCY_END_YMD )
